$ busybox
BusyBox v1.31.1 (2021-03-12 11:24:03 CST) multi-call binary.
BusyBox is copyrighted by many authors between 1998-2015.
Licensed under GPLv2. See source distribution for detailed
copyright notices.

Usage: busybox [function [arguments]...]
   or: busybox --list[-full]
   or: busybox --install [-s] [DIR]
   or: function [arguments]...

	BusyBox is a multi-call binary that combines many common Unix
	utilities into a single executable.  Most people will create a
	link to busybox for each function they wish to use and BusyBox
	will act like whatever it was invoked as.

Currently defined functions:
	[, ash, awk, basename, cat, chmod, chown, chpasswd, clear, cp, cut,
	date, dd, df, dirname, dmesg, echo, egrep, env, false, fgrep, find,
	free, grep, gunzip, gzip, halt, head, hostname, id, ifconfig, kill,
	killall, ln, ls, md5sum, mkdir, more, mount, mv, netstat, passwd,
	ping, poweroff, printf, ps, pwd, reboot, rm, rmdir, route, sed, sh,
	sleep, sort, sync, tail, tar, tee, test, tftp, top, touch, tr, true,
	uname, uniq, uptime, wc, wget, which, whoami, xargs
$ busybox --list | head -5
[
ash
awk
basename
cat
$ busybox --list-full | grep -c /
73
$ busybox ls /mnt
mtd
$ busybox MIRAI
MIRAI: applet not found
[exit 127]
$ /bin/busybox ECCHI
ECCHI: applet not found
[exit 127]
$ busybox --bogus
BusyBox v1.31.1 (2021-03-12 11:24:03 CST) multi-call binary.

Usage: busybox [function [arguments]...]
   or: busybox --list[-full]
   or: function [arguments]...
[exit 1]
